sources.entry: Pasteboard Viewer - Inspect the system pasteboards. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/sindresorhus/Pasteboard-Viewer) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1499215709?platform=mac)
Pasteboard Viewer - Inspect the system pasteboards.

summary.one_liner: Pasteboard Viewer is a developer utility app for inspecting the system pasteboards (clipboards) on Apple platforms, refreshing their contents live.
summary.what_it_does: It shows the contents of the various system pasteboards so developers can check what their app places on NSPasteboard or UIPasteboard. The contents refresh live and can be previewed as text, RTF, images, or anything with a Quick Look preview. Obsolete pasteboard types that have modern equivalents, such as CorePasteboardFlavorType, NSStringPboardType and NSFilenamesPboardType, are hidden. Users can move between items with the up and down arrow keys. Right-clicking (macOS) or long-tapping (other platforms) a sidebar item copies its type identifier. On macOS, a "Stay in Front" option in the Window menu keeps the window on top. The README states it is not a clipboard manager.
use_cases: debug what data an app puts on the pasteboard
preview clipboard text, RTF, or images
copy pasteboard type identifiers for code
verify copy and paste behavior during app development
how_to_run: Download from the App Store (link in the awesome-mac listing) or from the author's download link
Requires macOS 26, iOS 26, or visionOS 26 (older macOS versions have earlier releases listed in the README)
Non-App Store macOS build: download from the author's link; it does not receive automatic updates and is updated once a year
stack: Swift (implied by NSPasteboard and UIPasteboard APIs; not stated in README)
notable: Hides obsolete legacy pasteboard types with modern equivalents
Right-click or long-tap to copy a type identifier
Quick Look previews for arbitrary item types
Stay in Front window option on macOS
caveats: Requires macOS 26, iOS 26, or visionOS 26 for the current version; older macOS versions need older releases
Non-App Store macOS version does not receive automatic updates and is only updated yearly
Intended for developers; not a clipboard manager
keywords: see what my app copies to clipboard
